candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Internship in AI & Machine Learning. Building vision models from real image data, with clean preprocessing and reproducible evaluation, is the kind of work I have done in my own projects and want to do in industry.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. My computer vision work is in PyTorch and OpenCV, and I also have professional experience in data modelling and analytics.

achievements.impact: I fine-tuned a pretrained EfficientNet-B0 for retinal OCT scans, reaching 94.11% accuracy on a 968-image test set, with denoising, resizing and augmentation in preprocessing
for my B.S. thesis team I created training data and evaluated and tuned the EfficientNet-B0 event model
I built the Python pipeline that aligns detected events with timestamps and assembles highlight videos

letter.problems_section: I would help build reproducible preprocessing pipelines, curate and version datasets, define quality metrics and run traceable model studies. I have not yet worked with model quantization or edge deployment, and I would like to learn exactly that with your team.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate and can start immediately. As a non-EU student I will confirm the internship schedule against my permit's work-day limits with you. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
